__description__: GrowthOS Glossary — Maps natural-language retail slang and business terms to the exact system terminology understood by the AI pipeline. Used by MetadataManager and DataUnderstandingAgent at runtime.
sales drop: revenue variance via root cause analysis
volume effect: revenue change attributed to transaction count change
price mix effect: revenue change attributed to average order value or product mix shift
growth: revenue growth percentage period over period
growth rate: revenue growth percentage period over period
are we growing: revenue growth percentage period over period
trend: daily revenue trend over the selected period
daily sales trend: daily revenue trend over the selected period
sales pattern: daily revenue trend over the selected period
dead stock: overstocked items with days of cover greater than 60
slow moving: overstocked items with days of cover greater than 60
non moving stock: overstocked items with days of cover greater than 60
excess inventory: overstocked items with days of cover greater than 60
stockout: items at critical stockout risk with days of cover less than 7
out of stock: items at critical stockout risk with days of cover less than 7
stock shortage: items at critical stockout risk with days of cover less than 7
running low: items at critical stockout risk with days of cover less than 7
stock khatam: items at critical stockout risk with days of cover less than 7
reorder: recommended reorder quantity for stockout risk items
replenish: recommended reorder quantity for stockout risk items
restocking: recommended reorder quantity for stockout risk items
days of cover: number of days current stock will last at current sales velocity
stock cover: number of days current stock will last at current sales velocity
how long will stock last: number of days current stock will last at current sales velocity
sales velocity: daily units sold per product based on recent transaction history
demand velocity: daily units sold per product based on recent transaction history
fast moving: products with high daily sales velocity
inventory health: overall inventory status including stockout risk and overstock counts
stock report: overall inventory status including stockout risk and overstock counts
warehouse status: overall inventory status including stockout risk and overstock counts
churn: customers with recency greater than 60 days classified as at-risk
inactive customers: customers with recency greater than 60 days classified as at-risk
lost customers: customers with recency greater than 60 days classified as at-risk
lapsed customers: customers with recency greater than 60 days classified as at-risk
customers not buying: customers with recency greater than 60 days classified as at-risk
best customers: VIP Champions segment from RFM analysis with high frequency and monetary value
vip: VIP Champions segment from RFM analysis with high frequency and monetary value
top customers: VIP Champions segment from RFM analysis with high frequency and monetary value
loyal customers: Active Loyal segment from RFM with recency under 30 days
repeat buyers: Active Loyal segment from RFM with recency under 30 days
regulars: Active Loyal segment from RFM with recency under 30 days
rfm: Recency Frequency Monetary customer segmentation analysis
customer segments: Recency Frequency Monetary customer segmentation analysis
customer analysis: Recency Frequency Monetary customer segmentation analysis
customer value: Recency Frequency Monetary customer segmentation analysis
customer intelligence: Recency Frequency Monetary customer segmentation analysis
recency: number of days since a customer last purchased
frequency: total number of transactions by a customer
monetary: total revenue generated by a customer
discount simulation: what-if scenario modeling the impact of a percentage discount on revenue and margin
what if i give discount: what-if scenario modeling the impact of a percentage discount on revenue and margin
simulate discount: what-if scenario modeling the impact of a percentage discount on revenue and margin
price change simulation: what-if scenario modeling the impact of a price change on demand and revenue
what if i raise price: what-if scenario modeling the impact of a price change on demand and revenue
gross margin: revenue minus cost of goods sold
margin: revenue minus cost of goods sold
profit: revenue minus cost of goods sold
profitability: revenue minus cost of goods sold
cogs: cost of goods sold estimated at 65 percent of revenue
card: payment method credit or debit card
payment methods: transaction payment modes including UPI CARD COD CASH
store: physical retail location belonging to a tenant
shop: physical retail location belonging to a tenant
branch: physical retail location belonging to a tenant
outlet: physical retail location belonging to a tenant
sku: Stock Keeping Unit unique product identifier
product: item in the merchant product catalog
item: item in the merchant product catalog
alert: system generated warning about stockout risk or revenue drop or churn
warning: system generated warning about stockout risk or revenue drop or churn
notification: system generated warning about stockout risk or revenue drop or churn
tenant: merchant business registered on the GrowthOS platform
merchant: merchant business registered on the GrowthOS platform
business: merchant business registered on the GrowthOS platform
diwali sales: seasonal spike in transaction volume during October and November
holi sales: seasonal spike in transaction volume during March
festival season: seasonal spike in transaction volume during October November and March
